Alice H: Quick sync — I uploaded a KMS/HSM dependency heatmap and a small matrix mapping owners + blockers: https://redwood.internal/drive/kmshsm-heatmap
Ben K: Nice. Can you bold the audit-log ingestion row? who owns that end-to-end? @Carla M
Carla M: I'm the owner for ingestion. High-level checklist:
```
- endpoint: /audit/v1/ingest (svc: audit-proxy) - Carlos
- keystore auth: KMS token exchange (svc: keystore-agent) - Carla
- HSM attestation hook - Marco
- sampling queries for fieldwork - Priya
```
Carla M: Current blockers: staging HSM intermittently 503s; need an extra key for the rotating agent; missing service account in nonprod
Priya S: Re: sampling queries — I'll add a test set and basic eval scripts. PR #8123 covers the sampling harness, needs review.
Marco L: Staging HSM error logs:
```
2026-02-14T22:18:03Z hsm: attestation failed code=503 msg="timeout talking to slot 2"
2026-02-14T22:18:03Z hsm: retrying attempt=3
```
Marco L: I think the driver bump from 1.4.0->1.4.2 fixed this in one run, but we need a controlled smoke and a rollback plan.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: keystore-agent v1.7.0 -> staging at 2026-02-15T02:00Z by @ben_k :rocket:
Ben K: Can we shift the smoke window to 02:30Z? That gives Marco 30m after deploy to validate attestation slots.
ops-bot: Note: If staging HSM fails, automated fallback will switch audit-proxy to software-keystore for nonprod. TTL: 1 hour.
Carla M: Ownership update: Carla = ingestion owner; Marco = HSM attestation & staging ops; Priya = sampling + evals; Ben = deploys; Alice = heatmap + cross-team comms.
Priya S: Reviewers for PR #8123 — @alice_h, @ben_k — can you take a look today? :eyes:
Alice H: I'll review by EOD PST.
Ben K: I'll queue the deploy and stand by for smoke. If Marco flags any 503s >3x in 10m we abort and roll back. @Marco L please call it in that case.
Marco L: Got it, will watch and post logs. :thumbsup:
Carla M: Heads-up: ISO auditors asked for a simple trace of an ingest flow with attestation tokens — can we capture one successful flow tonight and drop it in the folder? (redwood.internal/audit/traces)
Ben K: I'll capture a trace during the smoke and upload.
Alice H: Updated timeline: aiming to close this milestone by 2026-02-16 so we can submit the artifact pack for the ISO gap review. If any >2 day blocker, we escalate to platform leads.
Priya S: Adding test plan to the heatmap doc now.
Carla M: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short runbook doc and link it here when ready.
Ben K: Thanks — ping if you need reviewers for runbook. :handshake:
Alice H: End of thread — logging action items in the heatmap doc for traceability.
